newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dura Pharma started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dura Pharma started.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown said analysts Barbara Ryan and Mara Goldstein initiated coverage of Dura Pharmaceuticals Inc with a strong buy rating.
-- said company has a strong position in respiratory market and should be successful in adding products to its portfolio.
-- said believes there is a sizeable market for company's Spiros dry powder inhaler.
-- projects 30 to 40 percent five-year growth rate.
-- set price target of 50 in 12 months.
-- Dura stock closed at 39 on Monday.
